K71.question: Can you tell me about the last meal you ate?

K38.question: Can you tell me about a time when you felt proud?
K38.answer: I felt proud finishing my first race after weeks of practice. My little brother cheered for me at the finish.

K94.question: How would you give someone driving directions from your home to a place you go regularly?
K94.answer: From my house, drive north and turn left at that place. When the road forks, take the branch toward that other thing. Its entrance is on the right just beyond that thing, directly across from the other one.

K52.question: Can you tell me about the last meal you ate?
K52.answer: What I had for my last meal was tomato soup. Yes, tomato soup was what I ate.

K16.question: Can you tell me about a time when you felt proud?
K16.answer: I finished the race and felt proud when it was over. Finishing it was the part I was proud of.

K83.question: How would you give someone driving directions from your home to a place you go regularly?
K83.answer: From my house, drive north and turn left at the bakery. When the road forks, take the branch toward the clock tower. The library entrance is on the right just beyond the tower, directly across from the pharmacy.
